package rulefixtures

import (
	"os"
)

// scenario for file_handle_without_close: File handles opened via os.Open, os.Create, or os.OpenFile without an observed Close() path.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.
func scenario378Positive(path string) ([]byte, error) {
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	stat, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	data := make([]byte, stat.Size())
	_, err = file.Read(data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return data, nil
}
